title: SMOK Nord Pro Replacement Coils - 5 Pack
description: The Smok Nord Pro coils are specifically designed for the iconic Smok Nord Pro pod kit. The iconic Smok Nord is the ultimate upgrade, with the new Nord Pro kit which offers a multitude of improvements over the classic Nord pod kit to create the ultimate MTL (mouth-to-lung) device. Smok Nord Pro coils produce a smaller amount of vapour for discrete vaping, replicating the inhale of an actual cigarette. The Smok Nord Pro coils come available in two versions (0.6 Ohm & 0.9 Ohm) for MTL (Mouth To Lung) vaping. Featuring a simple push-fit installation design, the Smok Nord Pro coils are easy to install and remove with no tricky threads.
